date_note: Date is ISB's notice of 24 November; the page gives no earlier detection day.
title: ISB finds traces of unauthorized access on servers of its FiT SDM and FiT Signage services and suspends both
summary: ISB Corporation says in a notice dated 24 November that it confirmed traces of unauthorized access from outside on the servers of its MDM services FiT SDM and FiT Signage. It suspended all services of both from 10:30 that day and is investigating the route, scope and any leak with outside specialists. ISB says no external data leak has been confirmed so far.
plain: A Japanese company says outsiders accessed servers behind its device-management and signage services, so it shut both down. It says no data leak is confirmed so far.
exec: A suspended MDM service leaves customers without management of their devices while ISB investigates.
action: No action needed; for awareness. ISB's notice gives customers no specific steps and promises to report new findings.

validation.note: ISB's own notice was read; note.com relays it. The notice does not say when the intrusion was detected.

review.note: title, date, 10:30 suspension, no leak confirmed, no customer steps against ISB notice and note.com
